title: MedRule Canonical Policy Rule Extraction Schema
description: Authoritative, canonical schema for extracting deterministic prior-authorization criteria across all nine MedRule clinical domains.

document_type.description: Controlled document classification type per MedRule taxonomy.

policy_title.description: Exact title of the source policy document.

policy_version.description: Published edition, version string, or revision date of the source document.

version_status.description: Temporal and governance status of the policy version.

source_file.description: Relative local path to the verified source PDF from project root.

source_url.description: Official publisher URL where the source PDF was downloaded.

source_page.description: Precise page identification within the source PDF.

printed_page.description: Header or footer printed page label (e.g. 'Page 4 of 29').

source_section.description: Heading, section title, or clinical subsection name where the criterion appears.

source_quote.description: Verbatim, faithful textual excerpt extracted directly from the source page supporting the criterion.

clinical_service_or_procedure.description: Specific imaging modality, diagnostic test, surgical procedure, therapy, or service governed by this criterion.

rule_type.description: Classification of the structural rule pattern.

conditions.description: Explicit clinical conditions and their logical boolean relationships.

operator.description: Boolean composition operator for child criteria.

criteria.description: List of atomic conditions or nested condition groups.

condition_id.description: Unique condition element ID within the rule.

parameter.description: Clinical variable, test name, anatomical site, or symptom being evaluated.

value.description: Target threshold, boolean flag, string label, or array of acceptable values.

sub_conditions.description: Nested condition group allowing arbitrary Boolean trees (AND/OR recursion).

required_documentation.description: Specific clinical records, test reports, or clinical notes required by this rule.

exclusion_conditions.description: Explicit clinical contraindications, disqualifiers, or non-coverage scenarios.

decision_effect.description: The limited prior authorization effect explicitly supported by the source text.

missing_information_behavior.description: Behavior required when clinical evidence is absent in patient record.

dependencies.description: Cross-references to other policies, place of service rules, forms, or coding grids.

human_review_required.description: True if criterion requires medical director discretion, ambiguous phrasing interpretation, or exception handling.

extraction_status.description: Lifecycle extraction and governance review status.

review_notes.description: Notes for the clinical or technical reviewer explaining ambiguity, rationale, or parsing caveats.
